settings.hero_h: No more switching rooms because of the heat.
settings.hero_sub: A vent cover with two fans and its own thermostat. It pulls the cold air your AC already makes into the room that never gets enough.
settings.why_h: Your AC isn't broken. The air just isn't getting there.
settings.why_1: Your AC sends cold air through ducts. The rooms close to it get the most. The room at the end gets what's left.
settings.why_2: A fan just moves the hot air around. Turning the thermostat down just cools every other room.
settings.step_1: It replaces the vent cover that's already there. Same hole, same two screws.
settings.step_2: Pick the temperature you want for that one room.
settings.step_3: It turns on when the room is too warm and off when it gets there.
settings.a1: It fits 4x10 and 6x10 vents. Measure the hole, not the cover. Wrong size? We swap it free.
settings.q2: Does it work for heat too?
settings.a2: Yes. It pulls in whatever your system sends. Cold air in summer. Warm air in winter.
settings.a3: No. Two screws and a regular US plug. No wiring. No ductwork.
settings.a4: Send it back within 60 days. If it's broken, we pay for the return. If not, you do.
settings.final_sub: Two screws, one outlet, and 60 days to try it.
